step1_analysis.circuit_type: Baseband Variable Gain Amplifier (VGA) with Common-Mode Feedback (CMFB)
step1_analysis.description: A pseudo-differential amplifier (XM15, XM12) with triode-region source degeneration (XM8, XM9) used for gain control. It features a continuous-time common-mode feedback (CMFB) loop (XM10, XM3, XM5, XM13) that senses the output common-mode and injects correction currents via cascode transistors (XM2, XM6) to stabilize the output DC voltage.

paper_reference.title: A 5-GHz CMOS Transceiver for IEEE 802.11a Wireless LAN Systems

gain_max.description: Maximum differential voltage gain (when gain control voltage N12 is high).

sky130_expected.calculation: With N12=1.8V, XM8/XM9 are in deep triode (Rdeg ~ 260 ohm). Gm = gm / (1 + gm*Rdeg) ~ 0.6 mS. Rout = ro_p || ro_n ~ 33 kOhm. Av = Gm * Rout ~ 20 V/V = 26 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact output resistance of the PMOS loads and NMOS cascodes in SKY130.

gain_min.description: Minimum differential voltage gain (when gain control voltage N12 is low).

sky130_expected.calculation: With N12=0.6V, XM8/XM9 enter saturation, acting as current sources with high output resistance (Rdeg > 50 kOhm). Gm drops significantly, reducing gain.
sky130_expected.reasoning: VGA gain tuning range is typically >20dB for WLAN baseband circuits.

bw_3db.description: 3-dB bandwidth of the amplifier at maximum gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cout). With Rout ~ 33 kOhm and parasitic Cout ~ 10 fF, BW ~ 480 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without explicit load capacitors in the netlist, the bandwidth is limited only by device parasitics, which is much higher than the 10MHz baseband requirement.

power.description: Total DC power consumption from the 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: 4 PMOS branches at ~150 uA each + CMFB tail at ~50 uA = 650 uA total. Power = 650 uA * 1.8 V = 1.17 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales with the chosen PMOS bias voltage (N5).

vout_cm.description: Output common-mode DC voltage regulated by the CMFB loop.

sky130_expected.calculation: CMFB loop settles when N2 is ~0.7V to sink the required current. XM10/XM3 need Vgs ~ 0.55V. Vout_cm = 0.7V + 0.55V = 1.25V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The CMFB loop automatically adjusts the output DC level to balance the PMOS source currents and NMOS sink currents.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point (power, Vout_cm), AC maximum gain and bandwidth, AC minimum gain (VGA tuning), and transient response.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Baseband VGA with CMFB Testbench

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N4 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 LABEL_NET_0 N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N9 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 LABEL_NET_1 N11 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N8 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N12 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N10 N12 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N8 N0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N3 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N3 LABEL_NET_4 N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N11 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N2 LABEL_NET_5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N0 LABEL_NET_6 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}

* DC Biases
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN5 N5 0 0.4
VN12 N12 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 0.6
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9

* Inputs (DC + AC + Transient Sine)
V_INP LABEL_NET_6 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5 sin(0.9 0.01 10Meg)
V_INN LABEL_NET_4 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5 sin(0.9 -0.01 10Meg)

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let vout_cm = (v(N0) + v(N3))/2
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print vout_cm power

  * 2. AC Analysis (Max Gain, N12=1.8V)
  ac dec 20 10k 10G
  let vout_diff = v(N3) - v(N0)
  let gain_db = 20*log10(mag(vout_diff))
  meas ac gain_max MAX gain_db
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='gain_max - 3' fall=1

  * 3. AC Analysis (Min Gain, N12=0.6V)
  alter VN12 0.6
  ac dec 20 10k 10G
  let vout_diff_low = v(N3) - v(N0)
  let gain_db_low = 20*log10(mag(vout_diff_low))
  meas ac gain_min MAX gain_db_low

  * 4. Transient Analysis
  alter VN12 1.8
  tran 1n 200n
  meas tran vout_max max v(N3)
  meas tran vout_min min v(N3)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
